Glossary for ramp.xds

Source: R/glossary.R
xds_glossary.Rd

A vocabulary guide to model structure, mosquito behavior, exposure, transmission, and the modular framework. Entries link to the concept pages and functions that provide fuller explanations.

Model Structure

Patch

A spatial unit in which adult mosquito populations and interactions with resources are represented. See xds_info_patch_dynamics.

Population stratum

A subdivision of a human/host population represented by its own population and infection variables. See xds_info_strata.

Aquatic habitat

A location within a patch where immature mosquitoes develop. See xds_info_aquatic_habitats.

Residence

The patch where a population stratum lives, which need not be the only patch where it spends time. See residence_vector.

Residence matrix

A matrix that aggregates quantities in population strata by patch of residence. See residence_matrix.

Habitat Membership

The patch location assigned to each aquatic habitat. See habitat_vector.

Habitat matrix

A matrix that aggregates quantities in aquatic habitats by patch. See habitat_matrix.

Mosquito Behavior and Resources

Search weight

A weight assigned to a host stratum or habitat that contributes to its availability to searching mosquitoes. See xds_info_search_weights.

Availability

A measure of accessibility to mosquitoes, rather than abundance alone, that incorporates search weights and, for hosts, time at risk. See available_blood_hosts and habitat_availability.

Blood feeding

The interaction between mosquitoes searching for blood hosts and hosts spending time in patches. See blood_feeding.

Egg laying

The allocation of eggs laid by adult mosquitoes in patches among aquatic habitats. See egg_laying.

Laying matrix

A matrix that distributes eggs from patches to aquatic habitats according to relative availability. See laying_matrix.

Emergence

The transition from aquatic immature stages to adult mosquitoes in patches. See xds_info_emergence.

Bionomics

The demographic and behavioral properties of mosquitoes, including feeding, survival, movement, and development. See xds_info_mosquito_bionomics.

Functional response

A relationship that expresses a mosquito bionomic parameter as a function of resource availability. See blood_feeding.

Movement and Exposure

Time spent

The fraction of time a population stratum spends in each patch when not traveling. See xds_info_time_spent.

Time at risk

Time spent when not traveling, weighted by mosquito activity. See time_at_risk.

Time away

The fraction of time spent outside the spatial domain represented by the patches. See xds_port_time_away.

Travel malaria

Exposure to malaria outside the modeled spatial domain. See xds_info_travel_malaria.

Visitor

A non-resident host whose availability and infectiousness contribute to blood feeding and transmission in patches. See xds_info_visitors.

Local fraction

The fraction of blood feeding on local hosts among blood meals on local hosts and visitors. See xds_info_local_fraction.

Environmental heterogeneity

Variation in exposure within a population stratum, represented through a model for the distribution of bites. See xds_info_environmental_heterogeneity.

Relative biting rate

A stratum's daily EIR relative to the population average daily EIR. See xds_info_relative_biting_rates.

Infection and Transmission

Mixing matrix

The biting distribution matrix that maps biting density in patches to per-capita biting rates in population strata. See mixing_matrix.

HBR

Human/host biting rate: the number of mosquito bites per person or host per day. See F_hbr.

EIR

Entomological inoculation rate: the number of infective bites per person or host per day. See F_eir and xds_info_transmission.

FoI

Force of infection: the rate of acquiring infection. See F_foi and xds_info_exposure.

Attack rate

The probability of acquiring infection over a time step. See F_ar and Exposure.

Infected mosquito

A mosquito carrying infection, which need not yet be capable of transmitting it. See MY_module_list.

Infective mosquito

A mosquito capable of transmitting the pathogen through a bite. See F_fqZ.

Infectivity

The probability of host infection per infective bite, potentially affected by immunity. See F_infectivity.

Infectiousness

The capacity of an infected host population to infect mosquitoes during blood feeding. See F_I.

Net infectiousness

The probability that a mosquito becomes infected after feeding on the modeled hosts and visitors in a patch. See F_kappa and xds_info_transmission.

Framework Terminology

Component

A group of related dynamical processes: XH for host demography and infection, MY for adult mosquito ecology and infection, or L for immature mosquito ecology. See xds_info_dynamical_components.

Module

An implementation of a dynamical component, selected during setup. See xds_info_dynamical_components.

Interface

A standardized set of computations that connects dynamical processes. See xds_info_interfaces.

Port

A parameter or variable whose value is set through a standardized function call with a flexible implementation. See xds_info_port.

Junction

A function that coordinates a bundle of ports. See xds_info_junction.

Forcing

Externally specified variation in parameters or dynamical terms, implemented through ports, junctions, or trivial modules. See xds_info_forcing and xds_info_trivial_forcing.
